display_title: A Manhwa That Ends When You Confess
description:
A clumsy girl, Song Sena!
After the most popular boy in her class lends her an umbrella, she ends up falling for him.
But every time she tries to confess, things just keep going wrong...!
A confession that always almost happens, but never does!

“Tomorrow, I’ll definitely tell him that I like him for real!”

Will Sena’s feelings ever reach the most popular boy?
